suspects.name: Brock Stone
suspects.personality: Stoic, observant, a bit clumsy under pressure.
suspects.physicalDescription: Sturdy build, dark hair, sharp eyes, often seen with a determined expression. He wears practical, durable clothing.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in the lab, attempting to secure valuable fossil specimens during the incident.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was trying to shield Professor Elm's rare fossil specimens when the explosion happened. I might have bumped into some equipment in the chaos.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He was secretly trying to acquire a rare fossil specimen that Professor Elm had refused to let him have.
suspects.lyingTells: Fidgets with his hands when discussing the fossil specimens.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Misty is prone to panic and that Lt. Surge is very by-the-book, perhaps too much so.

suspects.name: Misty Water
suspects.physicalDescription: Energetic, with vibrant red hair often tied back. Expressive blue eyes and a determined chin. Wears practical, water-resistant gear.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was attempting to initiate an emergency shutdown of the experimental device when the explosion occurred.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I saw the energy readings spike and rushed to the main console to initiate an emergency shutdown. I think I made it worse.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: She was using some of Professor Elm's equipment for her own unauthorized research into aquatic Pokémon abilities.
suspects.lyingTells: Avoids direct eye contact when discussing the emergency shutdown procedure.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Brock can be a bit overzealous about his fossils and that Lt. Surge is very rigid.

suspects.name: Lt. Surge
suspects.relationshipToVictim: Security consultant hired by the research institute
suspects.personality: Gruff, pragmatic, ex-military. Believes in order and control above all else.
suspects.physicalDescription: Muscular build, short, stern grey hair, a prominent mustache, and intense eyes. Wears a crisp, dark uniform.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was observing the experiment from a designated safe zone when the overload occurred.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was just observing the experiment from a safe distance when the explosion happened. I didn't touch anything.
suspects.trueMotive: To sabotage Professor Elm's research, which he believed was too dangerous and potentially disruptive to established power structures.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He was under orders to ensure the project failed or was contained, and he deliberately tampered with the device, believing it was the only way.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes overly defensive and dismissive when questioned about his exact movements during the incident.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He views Misty as an emotional liability and Brock as a distraction.

suspects.name: Nurse Joy
suspects.relationshipToVictim: Acquaintance; Professor Elm often consulted her on Pokémon health.
suspects.personality: Calm, compassionate, and deeply concerned about well-being.
suspects.physicalDescription: Kind face with gentle eyes and soft, light pink hair. Always wears her pristine white nurse uniform.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in her nearby Pokémon Center tending to patients. She heard the commotion and rushed over afterward.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was at the Pokémon Center, tending to a sick Chansey. I heard the explosion and came as soon as I could to help.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Lt. Surge is very stern and by-the-book, and that Misty can be quite excitable.
